name: configuration-chain-stays-in-the-project
description: A configuration file no program holds is read for its strings, and so is a file it imports by a relative specifier, but only while that file is the project's own: one below the target root and in no node_modules directory. A relative specifier that reaches an installed package's file below the target's node_modules directory reads nothing, and neither does one that reaches a file outside the target root, so a dependency only such a file's strings name is reported. A dependency the configuration file imports by name, and one a project file of the chain names, are used.
